Kim Crowned Batter of the Month in April
<Do-young Kim:player#53669> made his presence known as one of the best young stars in the National League this past month.

The <Seoul Yukies:team#403> shortstop shined through the month of April and has won the Batter of the Month award.

The 22-year-old hit .440 with 11 home runs, 32 RBIs and 47 runs scored.
